bind_US_standard.name: Keybinds (standard layout)
bind_US_standard.description: Matches Settings → Keybinds: binds a key to an action. Format: bind_US_standard "key" "action" flag. Wrong edits can break controls.

bind_held_US_standard.name: Keybinds, held (standard layout)
bind_held_US_standard.description: Matches Settings → Keybinds 'hold' modifiers: action stays active while the key is held. Pairs with bind_US_standard.

cc_linger_time.name: Subtitle linger time
cc_linger_time.description: Matches Settings → Accessibility → Subtitles: seconds a caption stays on screen. Larger values aid reading.

cc_predisplay_time.name: Subtitle pre-display time
cc_predisplay_time.description: Matches Settings → Accessibility → Subtitles: seconds captions appear before speech starts.

chroma_enable.name: Chroma lighting sync
chroma_enable.description: Razer Chroma integration toggle (in-game lighting). Lighting reacts to game events when enabled.
chroma_enable.recommended: 0 if you have no Chroma gear

func_break_max_pieces.name: Breakable debris cap
func_break_max_pieces.description: Max debris pieces per broken prop (crates, panels). Lower saves GPU/CPU; a low-level detail toggle.

gfx_amdUseLowLatency.name: AMD low latency
gfx_amdUseLowLatency.description: Matches Settings → Video → Advanced → AMD Anti-Lag. Cuts render-queue input lag; AMD GPUs only.

gfx_nvnUseLowLatency.name: NVIDIA Reflex low latency
gfx_nvnUseLowLatency.description: Matches Settings → Video → Advanced → NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency. Reduces GPU queue latency.

gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.name: NVIDIA Reflex boost
gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.description: Matches Settings → Video → Advanced → Reflex Boost. Raises GPU clocks for lower latency; more heat/power.
gfx_nvnUseLowLatencyBoost.recommended: On for competitive play, mind laptop thermals

hdr_screenshot_directory.name: HDR screenshot directory
hdr_screenshot_directory.description: Path string for HDR screenshots. Empty = default screenshot location. Rarely needs edits.

lookspring.name: Look spring
lookspring.description: Legacy Quake-style view re-centering toggle. Near-useless in modern Apex.

lookstrafe.name: Look strafe
lookstrafe.description: Legacy look-to-strafe toggle. Changes A/D behavior; keep off in Apex.

m_acceleration.name: Mouse acceleration
m_acceleration.description: Matches Settings → Mouse/Keyboard → Mouse Acceleration. Non-linear pointer scaling; usually off for muscle memory.

m_clamp_to_window.name: Clamp mouse to window
m_clamp_to_window.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window so flicks do not leave the window.

miles_channels.name: Audio channel layout
miles_channels.description: Miles sound engine output channels (stereo/5.1…). Affects positional mix; related to Settings → Audio speaker setup. Not a volume slider.

miles_dumpuploadtime.name: Audio debug dump
miles_dumpuploadtime.description: Miles debug dump timer. Players do not need it; non-zero may write debug files.

miles_output_device.name: Audio output device
miles_output_device.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Output Device: Miles output device name. Empty follows system default.

mouse_sensitivity.name: Mouse sensitivity
mouse_sensitivity.description: Matches Settings → Mouse/Keyboard → Sensitivity: hipfire turn-rate multiplier, combined with DPI.

mouse_use_per_scope_sensitivity_scalars.name: Per-optic sensitivity toggle
mouse_use_per_scope_sensitivity_scalars.description: Matches Settings → Mouse/Keyboard → Per Optic Sensitivity: scale sensitivity per scope. Off = one global ADS sens.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_0.name: Iron sights / 1x sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_0.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 0 = iron sights / 1x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_1.name: 2x scope sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_1.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 1 = 2x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_2.name: 3x scope sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_2.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 2 = 3x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_3.name: 4x scope sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_3.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 3 = 4x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_4.name: 6x scope sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_4.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 4 = 6x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_5.name: 8x scope sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_5.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 5 = 8x). Needs per-optic scaling enabled. Index mapping may shift by patch.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_6.name: High-magnification sniper sens
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_6.description: Per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 6 = 10x+ sniper). Index mapping may shift by patch; follow in-game slider order.

mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_7.name: Special optic sensitivity
mouse_zoomed_sensitivity_scalar_7.description: Last per-optic sensitivity slot (commonly index 7, variable / digital threat class). Index mapping may shift by patch.

name.name: Player name
name.description: Cached display/account name. The client usually rewrites it; manual edits may be overwritten.

sound_num_speakers.name: Speaker layout
sound_num_speakers.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Speaker Config: stereo vs surround channel count. Keep 2 for headsets or imaging breaks.

sound_volume_voice.name: Voice chat volume
sound_volume_voice.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Voice Chat Volume: teammate voice playback level.

sv_specaccelerate.name: Spectator acceleration
sv_specaccelerate.description: Acceleration scale for spectator/director free cam (sv_spec* is spectate-only). Does not affect normal play.

sv_specnoclip.name: Spectator noclip
sv_specnoclip.description: Spectator/director free cam may fly through walls. Spectate-only.

sv_specspeed.name: Spectator move speed
sv_specspeed.description: Base move speed of spectator/director free cam. Camera only.

sv_voiceenable.name: Voice chat master switch
sv_voiceenable.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Voice Chat master toggle: 0 disables all in-game voice send/receive.

ui_layout_mode.name: HUD layout mode
ui_layout_mode.description: HUD/layout mode index (e.g. 16:9 / ultrawide slots). Usually written automatically with resolution.

voice_input_device.name: Microphone device
voice_input_device.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Input Device: capture device name. Empty follows system default mic.

voice_modenable.name: Voice module switch
voice_modenable.description: Low-level switch for the in-game voice subsystem. Keep on unless you must unload it.

voice_scale.name: Voice playback scale
voice_scale.description: Underlying playback gain for voice chat, similar to Settings → Audio → Voice Chat Volume.

voice_vox.name: Voice activation mode
voice_vox.description: Voice trigger mode (VOX = voice-activated / open mic related). Combined with VoiceChatMode.

VoiceChatMode.name: Voice chat mode
VoiceChatMode.description: Matches Settings → Audio → Voice Chat Mode: push-to-talk / open mic / off as internal indices. Enum values vary by patch; diff the value after switching in game.
